Brand.Title: Economy Saver
EcoSaver
Brand.Text: Upgrade to Economy Saver to enjoy more baggage allowance, earn more Skyward Miles and be eligible to upgrade using your Miles.

Economy Saver includes:
• Seat selection available for a fee • Earn 0.3 Skywards Mile for every mile flown • Checked baggage allowance • Cabin baggage 1 bag up to 7kg • Regional multicourse dining • Complimentary alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks • Up to 5,000 channels of entertainment • Free unlimited online chat messaging for Emirates Skywards Gold members • Buy great value Wi-Fi plans • Eligible to upgrade with Skywards Miles at check-in • Changes are not permitted or for a fee • Non-refundable
Please refer to the terms and conditions of the fare and the rules of the destination • Please note that if the flight is operated by another airline then the onboard product or service will vary. EcoFlex

Brand.Title: Economy Convenience
ECONVENIEN
Brand.Text: Benefit from more Qmiles allowance and seat selection

Economy Convenience includes - Checked baggage 2 x 23kg - Carry on 7kg (1 piece) - 75% Qmiles accumulation - Standard seat selection - Refund to original form of payment (chargeable) - Upgrade with Qmiles -2 Date Change permitted, chargeable from 3rd Change

Brand.Name: COMFORTFLEX
Brand.Title: Comfortflex
COMFORTFLE
Brand.Text:
Choose Aegean, Europe's Best Regional Airline, and discover why customers come back to us time after time.
Passengers that need more flexibility and free baggage allowance when planning their journey and do not want to pay rebooking fees, now they can do unlimited changes. Also included are:
- 1 free checked baggage allowance (23kgs) - cabin baggage: 1 item up to 8kg and 1 personal item women's/men's handbag or a thin laptop case - Cold meal, hot & cold beverages, beer & wine - Unlimited free ticket changes (No rebooking fee. Possible charge for fare fee difference) - mileage accrual - Free seat selection in Standard seats & Upfront Seats - Wi-Fi onboard - free Text & Surf package (on all aircraft that contain IFE system)
• Please note that if the flight is operated by another airline then the onboard product service may be different to that described above.
